name: Name the interval
description: Ear training: two notes are played and you name the interval between them. New notes every review, melodic up, down or together.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Shown above the play button (also the card's title in lists).

fields.name: set
fields.description: basic (M2, m3, M3, P4, P5, M6, P8) | all (every interval up to an octave)
